title: 91 Bluejack Street Vacation Rental
meta_description: 91 Bluejack Street is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Nestled in the heart of WaterColor’s Lake District, 91 Bluejack Street offers a beautifully designed retreat just steps from the Frog Pool and a short ride from the Beach Club. With elegant coastal décor, inviting outdoor spaces, and access to the community’s premier amenities, this home provides the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and WaterColor charm.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included Parking for 2 Cars 4 Adult Bikes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Large Screened Porch With Daybed Swing and Dining Area Propane Grill Outdoor Shower Steps From the Frog Pool and Short Path to Camp WaterColor Located in the Heart of the Lake District 2-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club via Western Lake Bridge 7-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Welcome to 91 Bluejack Street, a thoughtfully designed WaterColor retreat where modern luxury meets classic coastal comfort. The open first floor creates a warm and welcoming gathering space with two cozy sitting areas surrounding a flat-screen TV and a beautiful gas fireplace. The dining area seats eight, flowing naturally into a well-appointed kitchen featuring high-end appliances, granite countertops, and ample workspace for preparing family meals or evening snacks. The first-floor king suite offers a peaceful retreat with a private bathroom featuring a shower and tub combination. Upstairs, the primary bedroom includes a king bed, private en-suite bath, and a relaxing soaking tub. Another guest room with a king bed and en-suite bath provides added comfort, while the cheerful bunk room, perfect for children, includes two twin-over-twin bunk beds and a large TV for movie nights. Enjoy the best of outdoor living on the spacious screened porch, complete with a daybed swing, dining table, and comfortable seating. The propane grill and outdoor shower make it easy to transition from beach to relaxation.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Combination Half Bathroom Laundry Area Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bunk Room: Two Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Life in WaterColor Set within the scenic Lake District, this home places you close to everything that makes WaterColor so special. The nearby Camp WaterColor offers family-friendly pools, slides, and playgrounds, while the Beach Club provides direct access to the Gulf and stunning coastal views. Cruise the neighborhood on the 6-passenger electric cart or hop on one of the included bikes to explore nearby Seaside and Western Lake. 91 Bluejack Street offers the perfect setting for a memorable WaterColor experience where each day begins and ends with comfort, connection, and the relaxed rhythm of the coast.
